# WO-211: monitor/1 JSON contract and --previous comparison tests
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Agent: test-quality
Assigned to: Nora assigns
Source: CLAUDE-045 (gap: tests/codex/test_cx_cli_json_contract.py has no monitor coverage)

## Goal
`freemyid monitor` (src/freemyid/monitor.py, cli.py ~1053) emits schema `monitor/1` (docs/MONITOR.md) and can compare with last week's file via `--previous`. Lock that contract with offline tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- Every documented monitor/1 field and status value is asserted against docs/MONITOR.md; one JSON object on stdout; documented exit codes.
- `--previous`: changed/unchanged/new/removed broker cases; a non-monitor/1 file prints the "not compared" warning and does not crash; malformed/oversized JSON handled.
- Fully offline: inject fake fetch/browser and `sleep` (the code supports `run_monitor(sleep=...)`); no network, no real browser, no wall-clock asserts.
- Table-driven; each test fails if the field or behavior it guards is removed (state in VENDOR_STATUS which you mutation-checked).

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_monitor_contract.py` (new)
- `tests/codex/fixtures/monitor/` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope
No src/ or docs changes. If the code disagrees with docs/MONITOR.md, report it as a finding with file:line; do not "fix" either.

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_monitor_contract.py tests/test_monitor.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex`
